notes: GeoChem Explorer 0.3.2 makes the Plot tab a full page editor, with annotations, key plans, templates, section runs and image export. GIS layers and surface samples can sit on a terrain surface, and ASTER mineral maps download in the app. Units can be set by element and sample type. Core photos load from any folder layout, RC chip trays get their own column, and block models draw quickly at millions of blocks. Projects re-import once on first open.
